title: 第23章 又是疗伤燃尽了的楚宁第24章 让你看为师修士不是让你盯着身材
slug: 师尊修为尽失后宠妻系统来了
content_zh:
第23章又是疗伤，燃尽了的楚宁并无戒心，是因为知道弟子早就对她有点别的意思了，可之前也并未做些什么。
她很信任弟子。
如果他真的是要做些什么，为何不是之前就做了？
而是帮助她恢复修为？
此情不渝，其中绝对会有师徒之情的。
一生相伴，呵......
趴在床榻之上，仅仅是穿着肚兜和亵裤的苏婉卿忽然发笑。
做师徒也是一生相伴，做道侣也是一生相伴，其实都能解释的通的。
可让她把弟子真的当成一个男人看待的话........
感觉好怪，他还记得楚宁小时候长什么样子呢，黑乎乎的，很可爱的。
现在已经到她床边了，她敢说让楚宁上床，楚宁还就真敢爬上来？
是真不把这个师徒身份放在眼里了啊......
不过苏婉卿并未介意，被这样的弟子喜欢，还夸赞她容貌好，其实心中也会有些小小的窃喜？
这种喜欢很干净，在这个弱肉强食的修行界内，实在太少了，她可以接受这种喜欢。
倒是接受弟子......呃，头疼的很，罢了，他要开始了。
带着老茧的手落在苏婉卿背后，那种刺刺麻麻的感觉让她感觉到异常的舒适。
老茧并不会弱化这种体验，反而是会加强的。
至于楚宁，为啥长春不灭三层了，还得这样修复？
其实早就能隔空渡气了！
但人家长春手，不能浪费了啊，怎么能因为功法进阶而忘却过去呢！

不能忘本啊哈基宁！
原本的苏婉卿已经是摸透楚宁的疗伤手段了，长春之意灌注。
可这次，很不对。
身后楚宁当即运转一身修为。
三层长生不灭，三境后期修为，能够生成的长春之意，岂是之前可以相比的？
刹那间，磅礴长春之意凝聚，瞬间通过苏婉卿背后经络入体。
如果之前的是小溪，如今这个，就是江海！
嗯~
一声猝不及防的阴角，是苏婉卿没想到的！
她都已经在控制了，可没想到，量这么大！
“宁儿！宁儿等等！”
她必须要先炼化了这长春之意再说其他的！
不然遭不住，怕直接就崩了！
苏婉卿立刻起身，楚宁也是一愣。
欸，慢慢修复不行么？
显然不行！
量太大了，这玩意就得循序渐进的来！
苏婉卿立刻盘坐起身，也没顾及前面是不是被楚宁瞧见。
引导体内长春之意，修复自身破损经络。
这次的进度，格外的大！

检测到宿主为妻子恢复修为5%，奖励贡献值五万！
楚宁原本一脸震惊盯着！
我滴妈，之前是真没发现！
师尊是真的很有料啊，这还是被保护着，那要是没了这层障碍，岂不是......
content_en:
Chapter 23: Healing again. The burnt-out Chu Ning was not wary because she knew that her disciple had some other intentions for her, but she had not done anything before.
She trusts her disciples very much.
If he really wanted to do something, why didn't he do it before?
But to help her recover her cultivation?
This love will never change, and there will definitely be a master-disciple relationship.
Together for life, hehe...
Lying on the bed, Su Wanqing, wearing only a bellyband and underpants, suddenly laughed.
Being a master and a disciple is also a lifelong companion, and being a Taoist couple is also a lifelong companion. In fact, it can all be explained.
But if she could really treat her disciple as a man...
It felt so strange. He still remembered what Chu Ning looked like when he was a child. He was dark and very cute.
Now that she is at her bedside, she dares to ask Chu Ning to go to bed, but does Chu Ning really dare to climb up?
You really don’t take this master-disciple status seriously...
But Su Wanqing didn't mind. She was liked by such a disciple and praised her for her good looks. In fact, she felt a little secretly happy in her heart?
This kind of liking is very clean. In this spiritual world where the jungle is strong and the strong eat the weak, it is too rare. She can accept this kind of liking.
On the contrary, he accepted the disciple... Well, he had a bad headache, that's all, he was about to start.
The calloused hand fell on Su Wanqing's back, and the tingling feeling made her feel unusually comfortable.
Calluses do not diminish this experience, but intensify it.
As for Chu Ning, why does Changchun have to repair it like this when it has three levels of immortality?
In fact, I have already been able to cross the air!
But people with long-term skills cannot waste it. How can they forget the past because of the advancement of skills?
Don’t forget your roots, Hakkinen!
The original Su Wanqing had already understood Chu Ning's healing methods, and was infused with the meaning of Changchun.
But this time, something was wrong.
After his death, Chu Ning immediately activated his cultivation.
The third level of immortality, the late cultivation of the third realm, the meaning of eternal spring that can be generated, is it comparable to what it was before?
In an instant, the majestic evergreen spirit condensed and entered the body through the meridians on Su Wanqing's back.
If the one before was a creek, this one now is a river and sea!
Hmm~
Su Wanqing didn't expect the unexpected sound!
She was already under control, but she didn't expect the amount to be so huge!
"Ning'er! Ning'er wait!"
She must first refine the meaning of Changchun before talking about anything else!
Otherwise, I won’t be able to withstand it, and I’m afraid it will collapse immediately!
Su Wanqing stood up immediately, and Chu Ning was also stunned.
Hey, can't we repair it slowly?
Obviously not!
The amount is too big, so this thing has to be done step by step!
Su Wanqing immediately sat up cross-legged, not caring whether Chu Ning saw her in front of her.
Guide the eternal spring spirit in the body and repair its own damaged meridians.
The progress this time is extremely great!
It is detected that the host restores 5% of his wife's cultivation level, and the reward contribution value is 50,000!
Chu Ning originally stared in shock!
Damn it, I never noticed it before!
Master is really very knowledgeable. This is still protected. If there is no such obstacle, wouldn't it be...
